claim.text: At 2.7213 s, the struck vehicle became a hazard by entering the ego lane.
Perception took 0.2398 s, which is below the 0.3 s perception threshold.
The handoff occurred 3.9417 s after first detection.
Only 1.0972 s remained from handoff to impact, below the 1.5 s human response threshold.
The CAN brake request was recorded at 8.1417 s, after the 8.0 s impact.
Once requested, brake actuation took 0.12 s, below the 0.25 s actuation threshold.
With nominal perception of 0.2 s, nominal command of 0.05 s, and nominal brake tau of 0.15 s, the counterfactual reported no contact.
The brake log was complete, so the timing record is not inconclusive on that basis.
The initial witness and the independent recheck both recorded no turn signal from the other vehicle.
